TIP OF THE DAY ☝️ Choose kindness over being right in every argument. ♏️ Scorpio. November 9. ✨ You are in your element with the Moon in your sign. TIP OF THE DAY ☝️ Try a new method for a familiar task. ♓️ Pisces. November 9. ✨ Let your imagination flow freely as you process your emotions. Your empathy is a superpower that connects you deeply to the world.
